# Font fixture

`AnonymousPro-Bold.ttf` is an unmodified copy of Anonymous Pro Bold by Mark Simonson. It is used for font-loading tests. The font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License in `OFL.txt`.

Source: [Google Fonts, revision `90abd17`](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/90abd17b4f97671435798b6147b698aa9087612f/ofl/anonymouspro).
